title: 📊 Daily Report: Wed Oct 28, 2026
text:
The Swing Desk book closed at $19,510.64, up $60.37 (+0.31%) on the day, beating Indy (the SPY benchmark), which gained $18.52 (+0.09%) to $19,861.69.

Against this week's Monday base, the book is up $333.35. CORE QQQ accounts for +$392.19 of that, while the strategy bots are down $58.84, so they're still in deficit for the week. Since the Oct 10 merge, the book is down $510.10 (-2.55%) versus Indy's -$160.99 (-0.80%), which leaves us $349.11 behind SPY.

Only Rota traded today, with 2 trades: it sold ACN for a +$8.53 gain after the stock's rank fell to #17, then bought 1 share of P (relative-strength rank #2). Trek, Dip, Sunny and the rest held or sat out. CORE QQQ's trend signal is ON (prior close 721.25, above its 200-day of 677.05). It holds about $17,552, or 90% of the book, with no core trade today, and it's up $392.19 this week but down $340.42 since the merge. Cash is $789, which earned $0.08 in interest today.

Research's analyst note (Oct 28): The Fed held at 3.75-4.00% in a 10-2 vote, with two members wanting a hike. The S&P 500 still closed up about 0.3%. Energy led on $115 Brent, and utilities lagged as the 10-year yield topped 5%. In AI hardware, Vertiv jumped about 17% and Micron (Research's idea) gained about 4.5%. GE Vernova (also Research's idea) slipped 4-6% over its $9B Trench deal. The solar avoids paid off, with Enphase down about 15% and SolarEdge down about 9%. After the bell, Alphabet fell about 7% on a revenue miss and lighter-than-expected capex, which could weigh on AI-hardware names tomorrow. Next up are Microsoft's call tonight, GDP, PCE and the ECB on Thursday morning, Lilly and Caterpillar before the open, and Amazon, Intel and Coinbase after Thursday's close.

Trading floor: https://blackk92.github.io/tendies-and-dip/
